methods.label: Identify the constant product
methods.explanation:
Inversely proportional quantities have a constant product. When the total cost is constant, the unit price and quantity are inversely proportional because
\[
\text{unit price}\times\text{quantity}=\text{total cost}.
\]
Therefore the answer is A.
methods.levelReason: This uses the Grade 6 definition of inverse proportion and a familiar price relationship.
